name: Personality
source: Personality is a story about a team of two high school misfits (18+ obviously) who have put the goal upon themselves to help the people of the world release and accept their kinks and weird fetishes for what they are.
translation: 《个性本色》讲述了一对格格不入的高中怪咖二人组（当然均已年满18岁）的故事——他们给自己立下一项宏伟目标：帮助世人坦然释放并接纳自己内心深处的特殊性癖与古怪嗜好。
